interpretation.operand_bytes: tensor shape times dtype width for each stage read and write; cache reuse and transactions are not modeled
interpretation.mapped_buffer_scope: current FP32/32-bit software storage, excluding weights and temporary scratch
interpretation.linear_macs: linear stages only; attention and other arithmetic excluded
interpretation.packed_weight_bytes: storage footprint of named parameters, with tied GPU address intervals counted once; not bytes fetched from HBM
interpretation.live_mapped_tensor_bytes: sum of distinct named tensor sizes alive in graph order, with initial graph inputs resident, all graph outputs retained, and each result allocated before its last input is released; in-place reuse, device buffers, scratch, and cache behavior are not modeled

execution_schedule.cache_policy: append each layer's rotated K and projected V before its attention
